name: slopeLimit
meaning: 4.12 min ground-normal passed to collision sweep 0x50e6b7; default 0xB54, 0x1000 after seesaw launch (moved from ScnMobile: only Sheep code writes it, e.g. 0x478db2)

name: slopeOverrideMs
meaning: ms countdown (g_dtMs) after which slopeLimit returns to 0xB54; set 500 by msg 0x27 (moved from ScnMobile: only Sheep code writes it, e.g. 0x478db2)

name: pTarget
meaning: current attractor / scent source / leader; reserved in g_flockReservedTargets when flag 2

name: pPlatform
meaning: object that claimed the sheep via msg 0x18 (carpet, train, elastic, magnet, GossamerOnde...); gets msg 0x1A on each move; keeps gravity active

name: pScriptHolder
meaning: sender of msg 0x23 (Sam/Monolithe/PrayingGhost); only it may grab while flag 0x20

name: fallTime
meaning: time falling in 1/4096 s; fall speed = fallTime*1500>>12 capped 1400; tested by 0x477c7f to enter FALL

name: stateTime
meaning: time in current state, 1/4096 s; zeroed by Sheep_SetState

name: gravityTimer
meaning: while >0 the update tail keeps applying Sheep_FallStep; reloaded to 0x5000 by movers

name: lastFoodPos
meaning: position of the salad being eaten; next-food search origin and WALK_TO_LAST_FOOD destination

name: carryHeadingOffset
meaning: heading relative to carrier at pickup; restored on drop

name: homePos
meaning: home: set to spawn position (ground-snapped) by Sheep_PostLoadInit; idle in-zone sheep walk back to it (state 0x12, Sheep_Update); Sheep_Reset teleports every sheep EXCEPT g_pCheckpointSheep here, so it is also the death-reset position. Observed in game: a sheep with this written walks there, and a Ralph death respawns it there

name: homeHeading
meaning: heading applied with homePos by Sheep_Reset

name: respawnPos
meaning: checkpoint respawn position, used ONLY while this sheep is g_pCheckpointSheep: written by msg 0x980 (which also sets g_pCheckpointSheep), read only by Sheep_Reset; initialised from homePos at load

name: respawnHeading
meaning: heading applied with respawnPos by Sheep_Reset for the checkpoint sheep

name: walkDest
meaning: destination for WALK_TO_POINT 0x19 (msg 0x981), y re-queried from ground

name: fallLimitY
meaning: Y cap for death fall state 0x14 (from death zone +0xC); default 32000

name: anchorPos
meaning: leash centre set by msg 0x2E (platforms, raft, lift...)

name: anchorRadiusSq
meaning: leash radius squared; beyond it -> state 0x1C

name: wallAvoid
meaning: {Vec3s wallNormal; u16 flags (bit0 active, bit1 turn side)} steering helper shared with Wolf (+0x2B0), used by 0x493ecb/0x494116/0x493e80; flags word at +0xCA

name: models
meaning: 0x10-byte model slots: [0] main, [1] WAR 0x52 AMOUTO03 (sleeping), [2] WAR 0xE4 AMOUTO04 (variant, flag 0x4000). s16 resId at +0 (-1 = absent)

name: pRepelZone
meaning: SHEEPREPELBOX (WAR id 0x35) box containing the sheep; its flag bits 0x40000000/0x20000000/0x10000000/0x08000000 choose the escape direction (+-500 z/x) in state 0x18

name: pWaterZone
meaning: water box (list 0x6d0c58) containing pos.y-60; flags 0x1000000 = freezing water, 0x2000000 = no-float; +6 = surface Y; supplies current

name: sfxHandle
meaning: handle of looping/voice sfx (0x142 bleat, 0x112 snore, 0x3D eat, 0x28 shiver); stopped on state change

name: state
meaning: enum SheepState

name: modelIdx
meaning: currently loaded entry of models[]

name: index
meaning: index in g_sheepTable, bit number in the flock masks and think frame slot

name: idleLoops
meaning: remaining idle animation loops before switching variant

name: flags
meaning: enum SheepFlags
